verdict.rationale: Kick ships an MCP server and CLI for agents. However, the evidence describes agent connections as granting "full access to read and update your Kick data" and "full control of your clients' books", with no mention of scoped, read-only, or least-privilege credentials for agents. The role-based access control in the security docs covers human team members, and "with your approval" describes action approval, not credential scoping.
